Quick operational note — we have a standard \"targeted log suppression\" workflow that runs in a maintenance window. Steps we'll execute:
1) Validate the thread identifiers against index (no full-table scans).
2) Create an immutable snapshot of the affected shard (for internal audit).
3) Remove identifiable payloads from telemetry/audit rows for the thread and replace with a one-line hashed record (SHA-256) with a suppression flag.
4) Store the snapshot + suppression proof in a sealed compliance container and emit an audit event (with operator ID).

If Legal provides an approval today, we can schedule the operation within 36 hours (non-urgent window) or expedite to 6 hours for business-critical with exec approval.
